name: 54949 · Manawa, WI
findings: ZIP 54949 (Manawa) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54949 (Manawa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54949 (Manawa) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
